# SEARCH source-boundary evidence

Run `sources/generate.py --check` from the original wave17c fixture directory
using Python 3.12. The independent supplement records 31 complete donor outcomes
for required catalogue status, source identifier and programme-field hashability,
and scalar controls. Direct and compiled CLI tests compare complete groups in
raw and accepted modes.

The original 65 scenarios, donor corpus, reference and wrapper evidence, Unicode
tables and all eleven evidence pins remain unchanged. The original README is
part of that pinned evidence; supplemental documentation belongs in this folder.
